subsections.text: BS Computer Science graduate from the University of the Philippines Diliman with experience in SQL, Python, relational databases, and data-driven systems. Built projects involving data collection, cleaning, validation, database design, and backend development. Strong foundation in analyzing data, ensuring data quality, and communicating findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

subsections.title: Full-Stack Developer Intern ( UP FLCD éLaan )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 5 | Client-Based Internship, Agile, SvelteKit, PostgreSQL, GitHub
items: Partnered with a university department to digitize its booking operations, replacing manual processes with a web-based system.
Collaborated directly with stakeholders to translate business requirements and workflows into database and application features.
Designed a normalized PostgreSQL database schema with backend for storage, retrieval, and validation of booking records.
Developed dynamic, validated form workflows in SvelteKit, integrating frontend inputs with backend endpoints.
Implemented user roles and validation rules to ensure data integrity across different booking scenarios.
Rapidly learned and applied Svelte, SvelteKit, and PostgreSQL to deliver a production-ready system within tight timelines.

subsections.title: Social Media Misinformation Analysis ( Misinfometrics )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 3 | Data Collection, Data Cleaning, Statistical Analysis, Technical Writing
items: Collected and manually curated 30-40 Twitter posts related to misinformation surrounding a Scarborough Shoal issue.
Performed manual sentiment labeling and data cleaning on over 50 posts through duplicate removal and missing-value handling.
Assisted in preparing validated datasets for hypothesis testing by ensuring consistency and completeness of all records.
Contributed to technical writing, research documentation, and presentation materials explaining the study methodology and statistical findings to technical and non-technical audiences.

subsections.title: Road-safety Mobile Application ( Metrocycle 2.0 )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 3 | Research Thesis, Technical Writing, C#, Android, GitHub
items: Worked within a large existing codebase, independently learning system architecture and contributing new features.
Led Android deployment, testing, debugging, and performance optimization efforts.
Contributed to the ideation and technical documentation of research methodologies and interpretation of statistical findings.
Presented the project findings to an international academic audience at the Workshop on Computation: Theory and Practice (WCTP 2025), communicating technical results in accessible language.
Published the study after rigorous academic peer-review at the proceedings of WCTP 2025 in Hokkaido, Japan.

subsections.title: Collaborative Workspace Platform ( SyncSpace )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 4 | Project Lead, GitHub, NextJS, Supabase, Vercel, Railway
items: Designed a normalized relational database schema and backend architecture for a collaborative virtual workspace platform.
Stepped up as the acting technical lead, managing meeting agendas, sprint goals, and ensuring cross-functional task alignment.
Developed backend functions and data-access layers using Supabase and PostgreSQL to transform and synchronize handled data.
Owned the multi-platform deployment: configuring Vercel for frontend and orchestrating backend on Railway environments.

subsections.title: QR-Based Class Attendance Mobile Application ( RollCall )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 5 | Full-Stack Mobile App, Agile Development, Ionic React, Supabase, GitHub
items: Developed a mobile application that automates classroom attendance through QR code scanning and session validation.
Implemented backend services using Supabase for authentication, attendance records, and course data.
Designed relational database schema and validation rules to ensure accuracy, integrity, and consistency across attendance records.
